title: Fire Chief 1 — West-Side Junction Explosion Report

lines.text: Control, this is Fire Chief 1, Corbin Falls Fire Department. We’ve just received a call from a resident at 1205 Maple Street reporting a loud explosion near the west-side junction and a fire in the storage yard. They say they saw a flash and heard a boom. The ERT says they’re not aware of any such event. Is this connected to the cloud?

Fire Chief 1, CCR confirms no fire alarm, no energy release, no seismic event logged in the last 10 minutes. The ERT is on-site at Rail Spot 2 and has not reported any secondary incident. Please maintain awareness but do not dispatch unless confirmed.
